checked_profile.summary: Auto coverage with optional rideshare protection and a driving-based pricing program.
checked_profile.scope: Selected product features and conditions from the provider sources below. This is not a personalized offer, approval decision, or complete fee or policy schedule.

facts.label: Coverage and deductibles
facts.text: Progressive provides multiple auto coverages; available limits and deductibles vary. Compare the coverage selections in the quote rather than treating full coverage as one standard contract.

facts.label: Rideshare use
facts.text: Progressive says rideshare coverage must be added to protect eligible use while logged into a rideshare or delivery platform and waiting for a request.

facts.label: Snapshot can raise rates
facts.text: Snapshot uses driving data to personalize renewal pricing. High-risk driving can increase rates; the program and participation discount are not available in all states or situations.
